remarks: Beautifully remodeled duplex in the heart of Belmont Heights , featuring a two-bedroom, one-bath front home and a charming one-bedroom, one-bath rear residence on an oversized lot. An exceptional opportunity for owner-users or investors! Situated on a spacious lot, these two residences offer comfortable living, thoughtful upgrades, and separate outdoor spaces for privacy and entertaining. The inviting front home features a welcoming living room flowing into a spacious dining area with a fireplace, creating a warm and comfortable setting. The updated kitchen features newer appliances, quartz countertops, subway tile backsplash, plenty of cubpoard space and convenient access to the backyard.
